apply.backup-failed: stopped and the file was not changed.
apply.write-mismatch: does not match the plan after the write. Run
to see which steps were written.
plan.file-changed: changed after the plan was made. Nothing was overwritten. Review the file and make the plan again.
plan.not-text: is not a UTF-8 text file. CedarLoom writes only text files.
plan.path-outside-roots: is outside the folders CedarLoom writes to (.claude/ and .cedarloom/workflows/).
plan.symlink: is a symbolic link. CedarLoom does not write through links.
store.locked: is in use by another CedarLoom process, for example a running cedarloom-app. Stop it, or make the change from the UI.
store.unreadable: cannot be read. Nothing was changed.
store.version-unsupported: The CedarLoom state store has version
, and this version of CedarLoom reads only version
